units.en: The ⟦0⟧ was the leader of the Axis powers in the Pacific Theater. They have a population of ⟦1⟧ (core) and an additional ⟦2⟧ (non-core). Japan seeks to further expand its dominion in East Asia, its "Greater East Asian Co-Prosperity Sphere" at the expense of all caught in its way. Its military has countless plans drawn up for its conquest of Asia, some involve an invasion of the Chinese mainland and splitting up ⟦3⟧ into loyal puppets, others calling for an invasion of ⟦4⟧ and others involve invading European possessions in Indonesia and Indochina. Even more tenuous plans call for an invasion of Soviet Siberia, to claim its vast resources and wealth, another plan involves targeting ⟦5⟧ and ⟦6⟧ with Japan's biggest ambition being the concept of an invasion of the ⟦7⟧ in order to secure the nation's resources and industry and to topple Japan's perhaps biggest rival in the Pacific.

Historical background

After Japan's unification during the Meiji Restoration of 1868, the Japanese Empire had undergone a period of rapid westernization and industrialization, with the goal of making Japan a power on par with the other western nations. With its newfound power, Japan sought to make up for its lack of resources by securing them overseas, through invading neighboring nations, starting with its invasion of Korea in 1895, the First Sino-Japanese War in 1894-1895, where Japan conquered Taiwan. Succeeding in this, Japan later fought and won the Russo-Japanese War against the Russian Empire in 1904-1905, cementing itself as one of the world's great powers and first non-European nation to achieve this status. Allying itself with the United Kingdom in 1902, Japan joined World War I on the side of the Entente, conquering Germany's possessions in the Pacific and China.

During the Great Depression, the Japanese government had become increasingly militaristic, leading to the conquest of Manchuria in 1931, creating the puppet state of ⟦0⟧. In 1933, further Chinese border territories were also conquered, leading to further puppet states, like ⟦1⟧.
Manchukuo
Mengjiang

Some consider that World War II actually began with the ⟦0⟧ of ⟦1⟧ by Japan, first by taking Manchuria and installing their ⟦2⟧ the ⟦3⟧ regime. In 1937, after the Marco Polo Bridge Incident, Japan declared war on China, beginning the Second Sino-Japanese War in which Japan invaded and conquered much of eastern China, installing additional puppet regimes along the way, including ⟦4⟧ and the "Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China". After invading China, Japan struck southwards, invading and conquering ⟦5⟧ and the ⟦6⟧ (Indonesia), in hopes of securing their resources, followed by an invasion of the ⟦7⟧.

On August 6, 1945, the ⟦0⟧ dropped a nuclear bomb on Hiroshima, flattening the center of the city. Late in the evening of August 8, according to the Yalta agreements, the ⟦1⟧ declared war on Japan, and shortly after midnight on August 9, attacked Manchukuo and Mengjiang. Only hours later, the Americans dropped a second nuclear bomb on Nagasaki, destroying a small portion of it. The total shock of these events forced Emperor Hirohito to intervene and compel the big six to agree on the terms of ending the war, taken by the Allies in the Potsdam Conference. After several days of backroom negotiations and failed attempts to destroy the stockpiles of biological and chemical weapons of Unit 731 in Manchuria, which were captured by Soviet paratroopers, and the collapse of the Kwantung Army, in August 15, Hirohito addressed the nation by radio and announced the surrender of Japan. The signing ceremony of the Act of Capitulation took place on September 2 aboard the United States Navy battleship USS Missouri (BB-63).

⟦0⟧, as one of the seven major powers, has a unique national focus tree. It is set to receive its own unique expansion of their national focus tree in the "No Compromise, No Surrender" Expansion Pack DLC.
Japan
The Japanese national focus tree can be divided into 6 branches and 20 sub-branches, with 3 additional branches enabled if the DLC ⟦0⟧ is disabled:
No Compromise, No Surrender
The following branches are only available if the ⟦0⟧ DLC is ⟦1⟧ enabled:
not
The Unthinkable Option Branch
The ⟦0⟧ branch is based around the idea of establishing a Communist state in Japan with the possibility of either joining the ⟦1⟧ or forming a faction with ⟦2⟧.

This is the hardest path in the focus tree, as it causes a civil war to erupt in the country. Even if the communists win, it will cause the entire Japanese Navy, all of Japan's colonial possessions ( ⟦0⟧ and ⟦1⟧) and most of the generals and field marshals to revert to ⟦2⟧, which becomes independent.
Strengthen the Civilian Government Branch

The ⟦0⟧ branch starts a civil war with the fascists and installs a ⟦1⟧. It allows Japan either join the Allies or form its own faction; the ⟦2⟧. It also makes Japan liberate ⟦3⟧ and ⟦4⟧ but, in exchange, allows Japan to puppet or annex the ⟦5⟧, the ⟦6⟧, ⟦7⟧ and Indochina.

Similar to the Communist above, this path will cause a civil war to erupt in the country and will cause ⟦0⟧ to become independent and gain control over ⟦1⟧ and ⟦2⟧, however, Japan will retain control of both its navy and army.
Support the Kodoha Faction Branch

The ⟦0⟧ Monarchist Branch is focused on deposing the fascists and either empowering the Emperor of Japan or restoring the Japanese Shogunate in a modern form. Furthermore, it focuses on preparing for war with the ⟦1⟧ and joining the ⟦2⟧'s faction. This path notably militarises ⟦3⟧ even further, by giving them Infantry Equipment and Aircraft Research Bonuses and it also creates a Non-Aggression Pact with China, however, it also requires Japan to join the London Naval Treaty, thus restricting their Ship sizes. It also accelerates economy laws, mobilises more manpower and gives a Research Slot. It also enables Kamikaze Strikes and unlocks a unique type of aircraft; the Suicide Bomb Craft, which are essentially flying human-guided missiles that deal ⟦4⟧ high damage, but both the pilot and the aircraft are lost in the endeavour.
The following branches are available if the ⟦0⟧ DLC is enabled:
Okada's Military Purge Speech Branch

This branch sets up a civil war in order to install a ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧ form of government by infiltrating states and swaying military officers. The player may decide to depose Emperor ⟦2⟧ and install his brother ⟦3⟧ as Emperor Eian if ⟦4⟧ is completed.
Appoint New Generals/Implement Army Reforms Sub-branch
These focuses are available when the civil war starts, but are unavailable if the player finishes The Red Sun Rises for a New Era focus. It modifies the Imperial Army and State Shintoism.
The Red Sun Rises for a New Era Sub-branch

For the Communist sub-branch, after the civil war, Japan may choose a leader, and depending on the leader, will then follow one of two paths. The leftmost path installs the Lecture Group, who gets their influence from Marxist-Leninist ideology. They focus on building industry in urban regions and establish a five year plan to build that industry. The rightmost path installs the Labor-Farmer Faction into power which focuses on investing in rural regions, reform the economy and unlocks the War Communism economy law.

Revitalize the Spirit of the Ikko Ikki Sub-branch The hidden Buddhist Socialism branch is available when Japan hires both Girō Seno'o from the Incorporate Buddhist Socialism focus, Jun Tsuji from the Cooperate with Anarchists focus as political advisors. Japan must also have Kanson Arahata as the country leader from the The Labor-Farmer Faction Ascendant focus. Once finishes the Raise the Red Flag High focus, it gets an event that allows Girō Seno'o as the country's leader. Then, these hidden focuses will become available. Japan can become the Jobukkokudo or the Pure Land as well as military bonuses.

Socialism in One State Sub-branch This path is available only if Japan selects a leader from the Lecture Group to power. This path focuses on the annexation of territory and the creation of the Fifth International to rival the Soviet Union's Comintern. It creates the Pacific Union of Soviet Socialist Republics in order to fight and defeat the Soviet Union.

Guide the Lesser States Sub-branch This path is only available if Japan selects a leader from the Labor-Farmer Faction to power. It focuses on creating puppets from Asian and Pacific countries and integrates their economies in order to declare war against the Soviet Union, United States and the United Kingdom.
Organize a General Election Sub-branch

The Democratic path sets Japan towards a constitutional monarchy. It may decide to select the Rikken Minseitō or the Rikken Seiyūkai as the ruling political party. Japan may then select a prime minister with various different bonuses.
Crush the Internal Factions Sub-branch This section in the Democratic path builds Japan's economic and industrial capacity.

Safeguard the Shanghai Settlement/Finish the Fight/Rekindle the Old Alliance Sub-branch This section focuses on creating or joining Democratic factions, expansion and requesting control over Asian colonies and economic integration with faction members. It may then fully integrate puppets in order to form the Greater East Asian Federation.
Revere the Emperor, Destroy the Traitors Branch

This path sets Japan to follow the old ways after a coup. Emperor Hirohito may support this coup or be forced into house arrest or assassinated. His brother Yasuhito may then become Sesshō or the regent to Emperor Naruhito, or he may take the throne as Emperor Genka. The branch is then split into six paths. From left to right, these paths focus on gaining advisors, industrial bonuses, stability and political power, war against communist nations, and military bonuses including the annexation of several of Japan's puppets.
Embrace the Kokutai Sub-branch
The middle path would then either place a shogun or the Emperor into power. It will then propagandize Japan's history for bonuses and opportunities to expand and integrate other Asian states.

Embodying Empress Jingu/Yatagarasu's Guidance Sub-branch These focuses require Empress Nagako, Emperor Hirohito's wife, as the country leader. In order to unlock these focuses, Hirohito has to be in house arrest. In order to get this, when the focus Revere the Emperor, Destroy the Traitors is complete, an event trying to convince the Emperor to support the new government will happen. Hirohito must not support the new government when selecting the "We have other candidates in mind". In order to definitely get this outcome, there must be at least 4 cavalry units in Kanto (282). Then Hirohito will need to be placed in house arrest via the next event. This will put his brother, Yasuhito, on the throne. When the player finishes the focus The Yamato Spirit. Japan will then follow an event chain that has the Emperor assassinated and then follow the chain to where Empress Nagako seeks revenge. Japan will be able to gain special project research bonuses and leader bonuses for Empress Nagako.
The following branches are available whether or not if the ⟦0⟧ DLC is enabled:
Hokushin-ron Sub-branch

Japan follows the policy to expand north into Siberia from Manchuria. It gives bonuses to Manchukuo, allows a temporary peace with China, and declares war against the Soviet Union for Siberia. Once complete, it gives resource bonuses in the newly conquered territory.
Nanshin-ron Sub-branch

Japan follows the policy to expand south into Indochina, Indonesia and then into Australia and New Zealand. It allows a temporary peace with the Soviet Union. Once complete, it gives resource bonuses in the newly conquered territory.
Revisit the Twenty-One Demands Sub-branch

In this section, Japan expands into the Asian mainland. The leftmost section puppets Mengjiang and expands into Mongolian and Inner Mongolian territory. The rightmost section expands into China, launch offenses into Chinese states and creates the Reorganized National Government of the Republic of China. It also pushes the country farther into Asia, either declaring war on or inviting Tibet, Bhutan, Nepal and Afghanistan to the faction.
Purge the Kodoha Faction Branch

The historical path starts by choosing to support the civilian government which gives Japan to temporarily ally ⟦0⟧ against the Communists or the military which makes an expansionist faction. It will then be able to build up ⟦1⟧ and
⟦0⟧. Japan may then propose the Tripartite Pact with the ⟦1⟧ majors of Europe.
Showa Statism
Fascist
The Imperial Rule Assistance Association Sub-branch

Japan will then become a Fascist nation. It may then choose either to have Hideki Tōjō from the Army, Isoroku Yamamoto from the Navy as Prime Minister, or have the country directly ruled by Emperor Showa. Japan may build up the Greater East Asia Co-Prosperity Sphere and integrate the members' economies. Japan can then become the Empire of Great Japan and core various Pacific Islands.
Solidify Tohokai Rule Sub-branch

This hidden focus is only available when Japan takes the Empower the Thought Police focus and the Civic Faction is at least influential. Then when it takes the The Imperial Rule Assistance Association focus, Japan gets an event where the Thought Police demands Seigō Nakano as the Prime Minister. Choosing their candidate will make this focus available.
The Koiso Cabinet Branch

This hidden branch deals with Japan losing their offensive war and the chaos associated with it. It is available via an event with specific requirements. Japan must: exist, has not capitulated, is not in a civil war, is fully independent, is in an offensive war, and the current country leader must either be Hideki Tōjō, Isoroku Yamamoto or Seigō Nakano. Japan must have either lost ⟦0⟧ ⟦1⟧, ⟦2⟧ ⟦3⟧, ⟦4⟧ ⟦5⟧, ⟦6⟧ ⟦7⟧, or ⟦8⟧ ⟦9⟧ or if Japan is nuked. It replaces the leader with ⟦10⟧. Next, sets off The Kyūjō Incident event which either makes Japan surrender in accordance to the will of the Emperor and accept the Potsdam Declaration and keep the Home Islands, or continue the war until the end with bonuses defending in core territory. ⟦11⟧ or ⟦12⟧, members of the Imperial Family will then become the country's leader. If Japan accepts the Potsdam Declaration, ⟦13⟧ will become the Prime Minister under a ⟦14⟧ government.
Ministry of Commerce and Industry Branch

The economy branch builds Japan's industrial capacity and upgrades the dynamic modifier ⟦0⟧ or ⟦1⟧. It gives influence to the if Japan decides to approach the big four Zaibatsu: Mitsui, Mitsubishi, Sumitomo or Yasuda for support. Those focus' time requirement may be cut in half if the player takes either ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ focuses.
